units.source_text: 搬运大网篮的家伙们，工作之前总得先穿过村落。

en.t: The men who carried the big net baskets always had to pass through the village before starting work.

units.source_text: 根据以前的经验，还有一个小时左右的富余时间。

en.t: Judging from past experience, there was still about an hour to spare.

units.source_text: 为安全起见，还是保证在四十五分钟之内为好。

en.t: To be safe, it would be better to make sure he finished within forty-five minutes.

units.source_text: 海角的延长线，像拥抱着村落似的，依次往深处蜿蜒而去，

en.t: The line of the cape extended inward in curves, as if embracing the village,

units.source_text: 一直到达东面的入海口，把村落的通道挤成狭窄的一条小路。

en.t: reaching all the way to the eastern river mouth and squeezing the village passage into one narrow path.

units.source_text: 要是到了那一带，海角的屏风岩就已经到顶了，

en.t: Once he got that far, the cape's screenlike cliffs would already have reached their highest point,

units.source_text: 最多只有剥去装饰的高高小沙丘。

en.t: leaving at most only tall little sand dunes stripped of ornament.

units.source_text: 朝右眺望村落里被薄雾渗透的灯光，笔直走的话，

en.t: Looking to the right at the village lights soaked in thin mist, if he went straight ahead,

units.source_text: 看起来几乎就是延伸到那周围去的。

en.t: it looked as though the way extended almost to that area.

units.source_text: 算算距离，大约有两公里……

en.t: Calculating the distance, it was about two kilometers...

units.source_text: 在那前面，已经是村落的外面，

en.t: Beyond that point, he would already be outside the village,

units.source_text: 那里东一块西一块像是散落着些掺着沙子的花生地，

en.t: where sandy peanut fields seemed to lie scattered here and there,

units.source_text: 记不起来见过有房子模样的建筑。

en.t: and he could not remember seeing any building that looked like a house.

units.source_text: 只要翻过沙丘，然后，再穿到大道上去也可以吧。

en.t: As long as he crossed the dunes, he could then make his way out to the main road.

units.source_text: 大致都是红土铺地的道路，拼足劲儿奔跑的话，

en.t: The roads were mostly laid with red earth, and if he ran with all his strength,

units.source_text: 到国道大约要十五分钟。

en.t: it would take about fifteen minutes to reach the national highway.

units.source_text: 如果能跑到那里，我就算赢了。

en.t: If I can run that far, I win.

units.source_text: 只要路上跑着公共汽车，也就跑着人的正气……

en.t: As long as buses run on the road, human sanity runs there too...
